purpose: Three review-only lower-body gait and independent-rifle recoil profiles built on the approved grip rig before production animation or runtime integration.
camera: one measured orthographic gameplay camera pitched downward exactly 45 degrees
facing: fixed down-right three-quarter gameplay yaw for all gait and recoil samples
lighting: the approved neutral diagnostic body and orange independent rifle under identical controlled preview lighting
prompt: No generated imagery is used in this motion stage. Inherit the approved eight-bone PlayerGripRig, add left and right thigh, shin, and foot chains with continuous lower-body skin weights, keep the rifle as an independent BoneAttachment3D child of firing_hand, and render three deterministic profiles with six gait phases and six recoil phases each under the exact 45-degree orthographic camera.
negative_constraints: no whole-body horizontal spin, screen-space gun rotation, one-handed recoil, floating stock, or detached support hand
no rigid leg regions, knee spikes, source-triangle deletion, proxy-sphere limbs, foot-floor penetration, or identical left and right foot travel
no identity, camera, yaw, scale, material, framing, or weapon-geometry drift between candidates
no 120-frame expansion, production atlas replacement, Player.gd change, collision change, or gameplay integration before selection

references.role: approved body geometry and complete topology
approved grip deformation, weapon depth, and exact-camera proof

candidate_outputs.focus: stable tactical stride with moderate lift and moderate recoil
compact shuffle with the smallest silhouette change and recoil
aggressive advance with the largest stride, lift, and recoil

generation_model: Godot 4.7 inherited Skeleton3D review rig, generated continuous four-slot leg weights, analytic two-bone leg solving, retained analytic arm constraints, and deterministic SubViewport rendering

selection_approval.scope: balanced tactical stride, 0.15 stride, 0.085 foot lift, 0.010 shoulder bob, and four-degree independent-rifle recoil; production integration remains unapproved
selection_approval.evidence: The user answered 继续 after the result recommended A; this is treated as acceptance of the recommended bounded preview direction.
